explanation: The value peaks at D2 and climbs through the episode: D2 is about 2-3 when the agent chose a2 and 5-7 when it chose a1 before trial 70, and 8-10 late in the episode (trials 85-99, more so after a1); D1 is lower (1-2 early, 3-5 around trials 70-90, 5-9 at trials 90-99, about 2 points higher after a rewarded trial than after an unrewarded one). GO is the lowest step, 0 before about trial 75, 1 after that, and 2-3 in the last ten trials.
